offices.title: Town Moderator
offices.org_name: Town of South Hero Town Moderator

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 148 (Town of South Hero): sec. 2: the elected officers are those required by State law, elected by Australian ballot

Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 annual meeting (526 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi S. King), published on the town website southherovt.org: the 2026 moderator contest had no ballot candidate; the write-in plurality (Rich Goggin, 125) does not seat -- the incumbent, Timothy Maxham, had won as a ballot candidate in 2025 and drew only 15 write-ins -- so the post stands without a membership (flagged on issue #163)

offices.title: Town Clerk
offices.org_name: Town of South Hero Town Clerk

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 148 (Town of South Hero): sec. 2: the Town Clerk is elected as required by State law

Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 annual meeting (526 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi S. King), published on the town website southherovt.org: Naomi S. King certifies the return as Town Clerk; she also certified the 2025 return
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Naomi King as South Hero's Town Clerk

offices.title: Town Treasurer
offices.org_name: Town of South Hero Town Treasurer

sources.note: Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 4, 2025 annual meeting (688 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi King): the voters authorized the Selectboard to appoint a Treasurer as provided in 17 V.S.A. section 2651f (YES 578, NO 83)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kim T. Julow as South Hero's Town Treasurer -- she continues in the office as the appointee after the conversion vote (disclosed on issue #163)
Town of South Hero, Selectboard page (southherovt.org): the five members are David Carter, David Lane, Graham Brown, Steve Robinson, and Anne Zolotas

Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 annual meeting (526 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi S. King), published on the town website southherovt.org: David C. Carter was re-elected to a three-year term (315 votes, over Joan Falcao, 184) and Steven Robinson elected to a two-year term (381, over Leo Wermer, 111)
Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 4, 2025 annual meeting (688 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi King): Graham 'Skip' Brown won the three-year selectboard seat in 2025

offices.title: Cemetery Commissioner
offices.org_name: Town of South Hero Cemetery Commission

sources.note: Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 4, 2025 annual meeting (688 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi King): James G. Robinson was elected Cemetery Commissioner for three years with 635 votes

Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 annual meeting (526 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi S. King), published on the town website southherovt.org: Samuel Robinson was elected Cemetery Commissioner for three years with 483 votes. One seat is filled each year on three-year terms, fixing the commission at three seats; the third seat's holder is published nowhere

offices.title: Library Trustee
offices.org_name: Town of South Hero Library Trustees

sources.note: Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 4, 2025 annual meeting (688 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi King): Gabrielle Ramseyer was elected to a one-year library term (586 votes) and Ken Kowalewitz to a two-year term -- remainder terms on the staggered board

Town of South Hero, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 annual meeting (526 voters; certified by Town Clerk Naomi S. King), published on the town website southherovt.org: Gabrielle Ramseyer was re-elected (454 votes), Kristen Bartle elected to a two-year term (462), and Elisabeth Wirsing elected on write-ins the return itself names (470 of 473 write-in votes) -- a write-in winner named in the certified tally is a certified outcome (disclosed on issue #163). The fifth trustee seat's holder is published nowhere
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 148 (Town of South Hero): sec. 2 keeps the State-law elected officers

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a constable; the office appears on neither the 2025 nor the 2026 South Hero ballot and no holder is published); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven South Hero justices of the peace: Karen Browning, David Carter, Emily Lee, Christine Mack, Carol Tremble, Kevin Winch, and Mary Jane Wirsing

jp_election.name: Town of South Hero Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the certified listing names seven winners for South Hero's seven justice of the peace seats. Note: ch. 148 sec. 3 makes the town's three listers and its delinquent tax collector Selectboard-appointed and sec. 4 makes the auditor appointed, so no posts are created for those offices; the town nevertheless balloted lister seats in 2025 and 2026, and those ballot winners are not recorded because the charter controls (flagged on issue #163)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 148 (Town of South Hero): sec. 3: the Selectboard appoints the delinquent tax collector and three town listers; sec. 4: the Selectboard appoints the town auditor annually
